$comment: Known real builds of the JZA80 Supra (BUILD_PROMPT 6.5), all on the factory longblock. Chosen before running the model (docs/research-notes/part2b.md). Excluded: builds with forged pistons of unstated bore, cams or ported heads; a 560 whp single-turbo car said to run the factory 440 cc injectors (they can't supply that power at factory pressure); a Dynapack sheet with no correction and no weather; Dastek, V-Tech, Dyno Developments and Dynocom sheets (no reading factor on file); E85 cars. Two counted builds by the owner's exception (buildCountException, 2026-09-30); the GT3582R build is shown but not counted. Research: docs/research/part2b/known-builds-toyota-supra-jza80.json, known-builds-gapfill-supra-rx7.json and known-builds-gapfill-supra-2.json.

buildCountException.reason: No third JZA80 build meets the inclusion rules yet: three research passes found only near-misses (docs/research-notes/part2b.md). Both counted builds run the factory twins (stock boost, and 1 bar with a front-mount cooler), so big-turbo builds are unverified. The owner is looking for a Saudi tuner's sheet to fill the third slot.
buildCountException.badge: validated on stock turbos only; big-turbo builds unverified

builds.notes: The spec sheet's '560 whp @ 5,200 RPM' can't sit with '470 lb-ft @ 4,800 RPM' (560 hp at 5,200 rpm needs about 565 lb-ft), so its rpm figures aren't used; the peak power is the headline figure. Correction not stated: the Dynojet default (SAE J1349) is assumed.

excluded.reason: DSPORT's spec sheet contradicts itself: 560 whp at 5,200 rpm needs about 566 lb-ft, above its stated 470 lb-ft peak (with 470 lb-ft, 560 hp needs at least 6,260 rpm). The research flagged this before the model ran; the build was kept at first and taken out under the inconsistent-sheet rule once the model was settled, where it lands 10.4 % low with its power still rising at the factory redline.
